title: The Toy Chicken
setting: A cosy family kitchen with a fireplace on Christmas morning.

characters.name: Ben

characters.name: Anna

sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) covers his ears in a hallway decorated for Christmas, looking toward the kitchen.
